findings.title: ADR-006 violation: inline HTTP call instead of make_client()
findings.explanation: Using inline httpx.get() violates ADR-006, which requires all outbound HTTP to use make_client() from app.clients.http. Direct HTTP library calls bypass standardized timeouts, retry logic, request ID propagation, and metrics.
findings.recommendation: Create a module-level _client using make_client('fx-service') and use it for all HTTP calls. This provides 3s connect timeout, 10s read timeout, 2 retries with jittered backoff on connect errors and 502/503/504, and request-id propagation per ADR-006.

findings.title: Hardcoded currency exponent assumes all currencies have 2 decimal places
findings.explanation: _to_minor hardcodes * 100, which only works for currencies with exponent 2 (USD, EUR, GBP). This will produce incorrect amounts for JPY (exponent 0), KWD (exponent 3), and other non-standard exponent currencies.
findings.recommendation: Use 10 ** exponent(currency) instead of hardcoded 100. The code already correctly uses exponent() in _to_major (line 17), showing awareness that different currencies have different exponents.
